objectives.description: Define specific target regions and adult population criteria to replace the 'all adults across five unspecified countries' claim.

target_groups: All adults in defined regions within five European countries (currently unspecified)

preliminary_activities.description: Conduct a feasibility study to determine the number of weeks required for advanced AI training based on skill gaps and market absorption rates.

expected_results.description: A defined set of target regions and adult population criteria.
Confirmed partnership agreements and a verified funding mechanism for the training program.
A revised, realistic project timeline that accounts for logistical constraints of advanced AI training across multiple countries.

proposed_indicators.description: Number of specific regions and adult population criteria defined.
proposed_indicators.measurement_method: Document review of project charter defining geographic boundaries and eligibility criteria.

proposed_indicators.description: Count of partner organizations with signed commitments for training delivery.
proposed_indicators.measurement_method: Verification of signed service level agreements (unit: number).

proposed_indicators.description: Percentage reduction in proposed timeline from 2 weeks to a realistic duration based on feasibility study.
proposed_indicators.measurement_method: Comparison of initial proposal against revised plan (unit: percentage).

assumptions: The current proposal's claim that EU approval is automatic is incorrect and requires a formal application process.
Advanced AI training cannot be delivered to all adults in five countries within two weeks due to logistical constraints.
open_questions: Which specific regions and adult population criteria should define the target group?
